fields.name: production_process
fields.rationale: The production process is a key differentiator for steel products, affecting properties like strength and recyclability. The document mentions the Basic Oxygen Furnace (BOF)/Blast Furnace (BF) route.
evidence: The steel products are produced via the Basic Oxygen Furnace (BOF)/Blast Furnace (BF) steel making route.

fields.name: product_form
fields.rationale: The form of the steel product (e.g., coil, sheet) is crucial for its application and handling. The document specifies 'hot rolled steel coil'.
evidence: This Environmental Product Declaration refers to hot rolled steel coil, slit coil and cut-to-length sheet.

fields.name: alloy_type
fields.rationale: Different alloy types (e.g., low, medium, high strength) determine the mechanical properties and applications of the steel. The document mentions low and medium alloy steels and high strength steels.
evidence: This includes low and medium alloy steels and high strength steels.
